response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and systems programming, and a Bachelor's in Computer Science. However, his resume shows minimal direct experience with the core GenAI requirements of this role: no evidence of Python usage, no major cloud platform AI system design, no vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), and no data pipeline work for AI. His only AI-adjacent experience is a few months (since April 2025) touching MCP tooling at re:cinq, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-solution development required.
strengths: 15+ years of proven full-stack and systems engineering experience across diverse domains
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience with Python, RAG architectures, or vector databases
No evidence of building AI systems on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
AI/agentic experience is very recent (a few months) and does not meet the 8+ years AI-specific requirement

key_factors.factor: Insufficient years specifically in AI-driven solution development
Strong general engineering seniority and leadership background
